name: Gudlaugr

related.relation: who bound him with the shift

facts.text: Gudlaugr is a level-64 named with 30,000 health in Dodens Gruva.
Roused, he turns into a demon wolf (rage form, Strength 330); the first time he changes he heals to full. His bite wounds snare and bleed.
Allakhazam says he lies close to the entrance to Summoner's Hall and looks like a small puppy until aggroed, when he grows to about the height of a troll.
Gudlaugr (Gudlaugr) is an Old Norse personal name (to verify).

story:
Gudlaugr was the jarl's hound, a pup of the great grey wolfhounds of Jamtland, too young to be left behind, who followed the last shift down to the cold seam because the jarl's son was on it. His name, a good Norse name, was the boy's joke; the jarl laughed and let it stand. When the shift died and the dead began to walk toward the voices below, the pup walked with them, because that is what a dog does. When Aros bound the shift to the mine, he bound the pup too. He was on the tally.

He is a pup still, curled by the stair that leads down out of the mine into the Summoner's Hall, as if waiting for the boy to come back up it. Players who reached him in the old days said he looked like a small puppy, lying close to the entrance to the hall below. He does not bark. He watches.

Wake him, and whatever the calling from below has done to him shows. He grows, and grows, and stands up a demon wolf the height of a troll, with a bite that wounds and drags and bleeds, and the first time he changes, he is whole again, every wound gone, as if the pup had never been hurt. The miners say it is the voice below that does it. It has been talking to him for a long time, because he is closest to it, and a pup listens.

When it is over, the miners say, he is a pup again, and he goes back to waiting. When he dies, he whimpers like a puppy once, and the dead in the mine all stop digging for a moment, as if someone had called a dog's name.
legend: Don't trust the puppy. Gudlaugr changes into a demon wolf and heals to full the first time, so don't blow your burst before he turns. Snare-break and bandages for his bite, which slows and bleeds. He lies by the stair to Summoner's Hall: if you're going down, he is your last test in the mine. His glacial emerald ring is a good drop. Some people feel bad about this one. He's close to the Summoner's Hall stair, so a raid heading down meets him last. Clear the area first, rest, then wake him with the tank in front. Some say pet him first, for luck. Don't.

loremasterTopic.text: The jarl's hound, too young to be left behind, who followed the shift down. He waits by the stair to the hall below, a pup until roused.

bookPage: From the second slate. The jarl's boy Ulf brought the pup down with him on the last shift, though the foreman said no. The pup sat by the face while we worked and chewed a bone and watched the dark at the end of the tunnel where the seam was. Before we broke through he started to whine at it. Then he stopped whining and just looked. Ulf said he was only a pup and pups are afraid of the dark. The pup was not afraid. The pup was listening. I think he still is.
